validation_gates.date: must parse against the source's declared date formats; undated rows quarantine unless the source declares undated_ok (document shelves)

sources.name: Gazette — Ministry of Communications (DoT, TRAI)
sources.quirks: Gazette of India ministry search. The legally authoritative venue, and the only source where the right to reproduce comes from statute (Copyright Act s.52(1)(q)(i)) rather than a site's permission. Reaching it needs a session token in the URL path, a Referer header (deep pages bounce to error.aspx without one) and an ImageButton postback with .x/.y coordinates. Citation is the Gazette ID, which is permanent; the URL is session-scoped and expires. Recovers DoT and UIDAI instruments that cannot lawfully be taken from their own portals. Ministry of Communications spans telecommunications AND the Department of Posts, so postal instruments are excluded by subject filter.

Now uses the engine's honest default UA (contact in the From header). robots.txt is honoured; access footing is the source's own permissive robots/terms per the legal analysis.

lanes.instruments: Documents that bind a client. Every row must carry its own citation and may trigger a memo.
lanes.signals: Real, useful information that is not itself a binding instrument: announcements, registers, court diaries, security bulletins, mirrors. Shown in its own tab, never in the instruments ledger, never memo-triggering.
lanes.judgments: Judgments and orders of tribunals and courts. Interpretive rather than obligation-changing: read weekly, never pushed as a compliance alert.

compliance.policy: The tracker fetches only hosts whose robots.txt permits the paths concerned and whose published terms contain no prohibition on automated access. A host that excludes crawlers or names scraping as unauthorised is suspended, not worked around, and the suspension is shown on the coverage page rather than hidden.
compliance.user_agent: Identifies the firm and a contact address. The tracker does not impersonate a consumer browser.
compliance.rate: About one request per second per host; roughly 53 requests per full run.
compliance.reuse: Metadata and links only on the dashboard. The optional PDF archive is internal to the firm and is not redistributed. Reproduction clauses on TRAI, CERT-In, MTCTE, MIB, CBFC and TEC require prior permission or restrict reuse, and bite the archive rather than the dashboard.
